title: List of bills for offerings, 5599

title: List of offerings
notes: Scan supplied as AJHS_P_15_4_267.pdf (104 pages): offerings books and loose sheets of Congregation Shearith Israel, New York — quarterly returns for 5572 and 5575–5578, offerings on holy days and Sabbaths 1818–1821 kept by Aaron Levy, accounts of offerings due, and a sheet of 1804. The file identifier is retained without treating its components as a verified archival shelfmark (presumably American Jewish Historical Society, P-15, box 4, folder 267). Also in the folder: dockets, a bill from Wm. Warner for offerings, 1817–1820 (scans 59–60), and a household bill paid 11 January 1814 (scans 100–101).
